tool.title: Pin readable page paths for an instance's ArchiMate views and elements
tool.description: Writes `cat-archimate.slugs.json` beside `cat-archimate.config.json`: each view's and element's slug, the path its page is written at, with every slug it had before kept as a redirect. A rename moves the page and keeps the old path; a claimed slug is never reused; a clash gives the later object its id's first hex; an Archi `slug` property chooses one. IRIs stay Archi's ids. `--check` gates it.

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: The instance root whose ArchiMate models get slugs.

inputs.name: check
inputs.description: Gate instead of write: exit 1 when the committed ledger is not what would be written.

selection.when: After adding or renaming views or elements in an instance's ArchiMate models, before committing; the first run turns readable page paths on.
selection.limits: Views and elements only; relationships keep id paths.
selection.cost: One parse per model. No network.
